summary: Adds email search to the users index, a self-service profile update, and a user delete endpoint. It also makes the User model send a welcome email after every save.

findings.title: Search term interpolated into SQL
findings.problem: The index action puts params[:q] straight into the WHERE string. Nothing escapes or binds the value.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated caller can inject SQL and read or change any table, including api_token values.
findings.fix: Pass the search term as a bound parameter and escape LIKE wildcards with sanitize_sql_like.

findings.title: Any user can delete any account
findings.problem: The before_action on line 2 now exempts destroy from require_admin. The destroy action then deletes whatever id the caller sends.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated non-admin user can delete every account, including admin accounts.
findings.fix: Remove :destroy from the except list on line 2 so only admins can delete users.

findings.title: Profile update permits every attribute
findings.problem: The profile action permits every submitted user attribute and passes them all to the update call. A caller can therefore set admin or api_token on their own record.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can make themselves an admin and gain every admin-only action.
findings.fix: Permit only the fields a user may edit, such as email.

findings.title: Welcome email sent on every save
findings.problem: The User model runs send_welcome_email in an after_save callback. That callback fires on every update, including each profile edit, and not only on creation.
findings.consequence: Existing users get a new welcome email whenever their record changes.
findings.fix: Run the mailer only after a new user is created and its transaction commits.

findings.title: New actions have no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds the profile and destroy actions, the search filter and a mailer callback. No test exercises any of them.
findings.consequence: Regressions in authorization and search behaviour can ship unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add request tests for search, profile updates, and destroy authorization, plus a model test for the email callback.
